description: Signed settled outcomes (Polymarket + sports) + whale signals as agent tools, paid via x402.
name: io.github.predgeAI/whale-data-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Funded Base-mainnet key that signs USDC micropayments. Either this or SOLANA_BUYER_SECRET enables paid tools; the free discovery tool needs neither.
environmentVariables.name: BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: x402 network: 'base' (mainnet, real USDC) or 'base-sepolia' (only against a testnet deployment).
environmentVariables.name: X402_NETWORK

environmentVariables.description: Hard per-call price cap in USD. Calls priced above it are refused before any payment. Default 0.05.
environmentVariables.name: MAX_PRICE_USD

environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to the production deployment.
environmentVariables.name: PREDGE_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Funded Solana-mainnet key (64-number JSON array or base58) to also pay on Solana. Optional — either this or BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY enables paid tools.
environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_BUYER_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Solana network: 'solana' (mainnet) or 'solana-devnet'. Defaults to match X402_NETWORK's testnet-ness.
environmentVariables.name: X402_SOLANA_NETWORK

environmentVariables.description: Optional custom Solana RPC (the public mainnet-beta endpoint is rate-limited).
environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL
